title: Dreamy auto-shooter roguelite where you play a droplet of liquid metal dashing across five tiny worlds while your shots fire themselves
author: One_Low8664
selftext:
[https://bug.games/games/perlune](https://bug.games/games/perlune)

Perlune was built with Opus 5.5 over a few conversations about 4,600 lines of plain JavaScript and raw WebGL 2 with no engine, libraries or assets

Every creature, enemy and planet is assembled each frame from a few procedural primitives in an instanced renderer, with chrome, glass, pearl and liquid materials reflecting a procedural environment instead of cubemaps

comments.author: Csilo
comments.body:
Cool aesthetic but I think the gameplay loop could use some work. Not being able who those bullets are being shot at long distances make it kinda pointless.
Anyway I've been surfing this sub almost daily and most posts I find look like the usual slop. But it's the second time you made me stop and take a look so you're definitely cooking. That's the kind of way AI should be used for in game dev. Great work!

comments.author: Anipixels
comments.body: omg looks so fun and unique! nice one bro

comments.author: hyperg8_games
comments.body: thats impressive for ~4,600 lines of plain JS and raw WebGL 2 without engine or assets, the chrome and liquid materials built from procedural primitives is the part I would love to hear more about. Did Opus get the instanced renderer right from the first conversations or did you have to fix a lot of it yourself? If you want more players than on bug.games, web portals like CrazyGames or Playgama could be an option, I publish my own games on both. From my experience Playgama is the easiest of all platforms to get published on, but the review can take 1-5 days and the minimum payout is 100$, which I havent reached yet. On CrazyGames its only ad revenue, so its not big money, for me the real value was seeing if a concept actually works with players

comments.author: ZHName
comments.body: Most creative thing I have seen this month in terms of gameplay and unique look.
